front: Amplify your voice so it carries loudly and clearly to everyone within 500 feet, and gain a small bonus to Coerce and large-venue Performance.
back:
Voice heard clearly within 500 ft, over ambient noise; not jarring. Doesn't extend range/area of other effects; walls and doors still block it.
+1 status bonus to checks to Coerce and auditory Performance at a large venue.
Can Dismiss.
Heightened (5th): 1,200 feet.
(7th): 1 mile.
